Several hours (9 missions and lots of travelling)

The shaman {npc:Hairycles}, of Banuta, wants to find true friends among humans. Over 9 missions you go to Trapwood, Carlin, Chor, Ankrahmun, Fibula, the Forbidden Lands and the depths of Banuta to cure the apes' plague and destroy the serpent god's monument. At the end you get the {wiki:Shaman Outfits|Shaman Outfits}, monkey statues for your house and access to the Forbidden Lands and Deeper Banuta.
The famous Merlkin Hairycles is trying to find true friends among humans. To prove you can be one of them, you must help the apes.
Hairycles, temple in the southeast of Banuta
No minimum level, but the recommended level is **130+** (for the last mission, in Deeper Banuta, a team is advisable; whoever runs the levers should be level 200+).
Plenty of money for travel (Port Hope, Carlin, Ankrahmun, Thais/Fibula).
mission 2; buy it from Padreia in Carlin for 50 gp (better to buy it beforehand)
mission 5; better to buy it beforehand, on the Market
mission 6; buy it from Simon the Beggar (800 gp) or Dermot (2,000 gp)
mission 7, to destroy the Small Casks
A **melee weapon** to break the Wooden Bars and the amphorae (the {item:Crowbar} works too; the {item:Snake Destroyer} doesn't)
recommended 1 per team member for the last mission
optional: opens a secret tunnel from Tiquanda to Deeper Banuta
given by Hairycles in mission 9 — don't forget it!
{npc:Hairycles} starts healing you when you're low on health
You can buy {item:Banana|Bananas} from Hairycles for 2 gp
Access to the {wiki:Forbidden Lands|Forbidden Lands} and {wiki:Deeper Banuta|Deeper Banuta}
In mission 6 (Witches' Cap Spot), when you become a *friend of the apes*: {npc:Hairycles} heals you when you are low on health (ask for {key:healing}).
In mission 6 (Witches' Cap Spot), when you become a *friend of the apes*.
Forbidden Lands (transport by The Blind Prophet)
In mission 8, when {npc:Hairycles} gives you permission: {npc:The Blind Prophet} will take you there ({key:transport}).
In mission 9 (The Deepest Catacombs), when {npc:Hairycles} gives you the {item:Snake Destroyer}.
Monkey Statues for your house for sale from Hairycles
At the end of the quest, after receiving the Shaman Outfits.
Before starting, buy {item:Cough Syrup} (Padreia, Carlin) and a {item:Hydra Egg} (Market): you save two trips to Banuta.
In every mission the pattern is the same: say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to {npc:Hairycles}, accept with {key:yes}, do the task and say {key:mission} again to hand it in.
For mission 9 **always** bring the {item:Snake Destroyer}. Without it you can't finish the quest and you lose a lot of time.
In Banuta there are many apes ({creature:Kongra|Kongras}, {creature:Merlkin|Merlkins} and {creature:Sibang|Sibangs}). Mages: bring {item:Avalanche Rune|Avalanche Runes}.

Take a boat to **Port Hope** (say {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} to the port captain); you arrive at {npc:Charles}'s port. From Port Hope cross the Tiquanda jungle to the **northeast** to {wiki:Banuta}. If you have the **Ranger** rank in the {wiki:Paw and Fur Society}, {npc:Lorek}, at the far **east** of Port Hope, takes you straight to Banuta for 30 gp.

Go to **Banuta**, the ape city in Tiquanda, and head for {npc:Hairycles}' temple, in the **southeast** of the city. Go up to the **first floor above ground**: that's where Hairycles, the main NPC of the quest, is.
On the way you'll find {creature:Carniphila|Carniphilas}, the usual Tiquanda monsters and lots of apes of every kind.

Whenever a mission sends you outside Banuta, come down from the temple and cross the jungle to the **southwest** to Port Hope, where {npc:Charles} takes you by boat to other cities. To come back, do the "Getting to Banuta" step.

Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} to {npc:Hairycles}. He tells you a plague has struck a small ape and asks you for {item:Whisper Moss}, which the {wiki:Dworcs|dworcs} keep in the east part of the upper floor of their lair.

Go to **Trapwood**, the southern part of Tiquanda, and fall into the **southeasternmost** {wiki:Pitfall|pitfall}, which leads to the {wiki:Dworc Caves|Dworc Caves}. If you fall into another pitfall you have to make your way to the right room. Trapwood is **south** of Port Hope: leave the city and walk south.
Break the bars and open the box
Use a melee weapon on the damaged {item:Wooden Bars}. In the **east** part of this room there is a {item:Door (Sealed)|quest door}: go in and open the box inside to receive the {item:Whisper Moss}.
The quest door with the Whisper Moss box

The pitfalls only go down: do not go back the way you fell. To return to the Trapwood surface, look for the way out of the caves (the Dworc Caves have an entrance with stairs and some holes with rope spots, so bring a {item:Rope}); the wiki does not detail the route from this room. Then head back **north** to Port Hope, and from there to Banuta.
Go back to {npc:Hairycles} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Hairycles}. He needs **cough syrup**, the syrup humans use.

The story leads through {npc:Brewster} ({key:cough syrup}), who sends you to {npc:Ustan} ({key:cough syrup}), who tells you the syrup was stolen in an ape attack and sends you to the druid guild in Carlin. If you already know this, you can go straight to Carlin.

Go to **Carlin**, to the Druid Guild, and talk to {npc:Padreia}: {key:hi}, {key:cough syrup}, {key:yes}. It costs **50 gp**. To return to Banuta, take a boat to Port Hope and follow the step “Getting to Banuta”.
Buy the Cough Syrup from Padreia
You can buy it before starting the quest or get it from another player: you do not have to be the one who buys it.
Say {key:mission}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} to {npc:Hairycles}. He thinks the plague is the work of the {wiki:Lizards|lizards} and wants the papers of the lizard mage in the city of **Chor**.

{wiki:Chor|Chor} is **southeast** of Port Hope. The easiest way is to leave through the **south** part of Port Hope and keep walking **east** (you avoid the Hydra and the elephants in the north), until the log bridge over the river. You can also come from **Ankrahmun** through the Kha'zeel mountains (you only meet a few Nomads and Bandits) or, with the **Ranger** rank in the {wiki:Paw and Fur Society}, go with {npc:Lorek} on a **one-way** boat to Chor (30 gp).
Prepare your team and enter {wiki:Chor|Chor} through the **southwest** log. Go **south**, cross the bridge and turn **east**.
Cyan = log to enter Chor; yellow = Old Parchment

Chor is full of lizards. A mage with {spell:Great Fireball} helps a lot. Kill the {creature:Lizard Snakecharmer|Lizard Snakecharmers} first, because the {creature:Cobra|Cobras} they summon are annoying.
A {item:Stealth Ring} works against the {creature:Lizard Templar|Lizard Templars}, but the other two types of lizard still see you. The Templars are the only ones that try to surround you.
You find a building with a {item:Door (Sealed)|quest door} on the **east** side. Go in and open the box to receive the {item:Old Parchment}.
The room with the Old Parchment box

Go back on foot the same way: leave through the **southwest** log, cross the bridge and head **west** to Port Hope (or go back to Ankrahmun through the Kha'zeel mountains, if you came that way). {npc:Lorek}'s boat does not make the return trip.
Say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to {npc:Hairycles}. He cannot read the parchment and sends you to a stone with signs in a tomb east of the desert city.

Go to **Ankrahmun** and leave the city through the **northeast** exit. Follow the walls **southeast** and dig with the {item:Shovel} at the marked spot to enter the {wiki:Shadow Tomb|Shadow Tomb}. To go to Ankrahmun by boat, say {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes} to the port captain.
Read the signs on the obelisk

Go down in the tomb to the **second main floor**, the floor with the blue flame (do not walk through it). From the ramp go **south** and then keep going **east** to the end, where there is an {wiki:Obelisk|obelisk} and 4 {item:Red Shrine Stone|Red Shrine Stones}. Approach the obelisk to decipher the parchment. The text *"!-! -O- I_I (/( --I Morgathla"* appears above your head.
Map of the second floor of the Shadow Tomb with the obelisk
The obelisk between the red stones

In the tomb there are {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Scarab|Scarabs}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Crypt Shambler|Crypt Shamblers} and 1 {creature:Fire Devil}. {creature:Stalker|Stalkers}, {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}, {creature:Vampire|Vampires} and {creature:Mummy|Mummies} brought by other players may also appear.
You do not need to carry the parchment with you to decipher it.

Go back the same way: go up the floors of the {wiki:Shadow Tomb} to the entrance and use the {item:Rope} on the hole you dug to get out to the desert. Then return to **Ankrahmun** by the city's **northeast** ramp and take the boat to Port Hope.
Shadow Tomb entrance (go up with the Rope)
Say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to {npc:Hairycles}. He needs a {item:Hydra Egg} for his amulet.

**Any** {item:Hydra Egg} will do. The simplest is to buy it on the **Market** (it is common loot from {creature:Hydra|Hydras}). If you cannot, kill hydras or fetch it from the {wiki:Hydra's Nest|Hydra's Nest} of the {wiki:Hydra Egg Quest|Hydra Egg Quest}.
Yellow = Hydra Egg Quest; red = Hydra
If you do not buy the egg, expect to fight one or more {creature:Hydra|Hydras}.

Say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to {npc:Hairycles}. He wants a sample of the {item:Witches' Cap Spot} mushroom, which only exists in the {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} area of the {wiki:Fibula Dungeon|Fibula Dungeon}.
Go to Fibula and get the key

Go to **Fibula**, through the tunnel far south of **Thais**. You need the {item:Key 3940}: if you do not have it, buy it from {npc:Simon the Beggar} (800 gp) or {npc:Dermot} (2,000 gp). The tunnel starts south of Thais; walk through it on foot to the island.

Use the {item:Draw Well|well} in the middle of the small village to enter the Fibula Dungeon. Follow the path **south**, **east** and then **north**, cross a bridge and use the key on the door (if it is locked). Go in and go down the stairs inside.
First floor of the Fibula Dungeon

Go straight **south**, pass the door and go down one of the two ladders at the end of the corridor. Keep going **south** to the end and then turn **west** until you hit a wall. You find a {item:Door (Sealed)|quest door}: go in and use the {item:Witches' Cap Spot} to collect a sample.
Location of the quest door in the Fibula Dungeon
The quest door and the Witches' Cap Spot
The sample lasts **24 hours**. If you lose it, you can only get another 24 hours after you picked up the first one.

Go back the same way: climb the ladder and the stairs, return over the bridge and through the door to the well you came in by and go up to the village of Fibula. Then go back to Thais through the tunnel and take the boat to Port Hope.

Go back to {npc:Hairycles}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. You become a **friend of the apes**: you can buy {item:Banana|Bananas} for 2 gp and Hairycles heals you when you are low on health (ask for {key:healing}).
Bananas at 2 gp and free healing from Hairycles

Say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to {npc:Hairycles}. He wants you to destroy **3** {item:Small Cask|Small Casks} with red fluid in the underground lizard temple, beneath the city. You need a {item:Crowbar}.
From Hairycles go down **twice** to enter the basement. Bring a {item:Rope}.
Go **north** and follow the corridor to a big room full of apes. Turn **west** and go down the stairs at the end of the hall.

Go **east**, **north**, **west** and **north** again. Ignore the first exit to the **east** and take the **second**. Follow the passage to a big room with many apes and 7 {item:Cask|Casks} on the **east** side.
Here you find the Small Casks
There are many apes underground. Mages: bring {item:Avalanche Rune|Avalanche Runes}.
Go into each door and use the {item:Crowbar} on the casks until you have destroyed **3**.
One of the three casks destroyed
3 casks are needed per person. In large groups you may have to wait for them to respawn (about 3–5 minutes).
Go back the same way: return to the hall full of apes, go up the stairs at the back of the hall and then go up **twice** to {npc:Hairycles}'s floor.
Go back to {npc:Hairycles} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}.
After the last mission, this is the hardest part of the quest.
Say {key:mission} again and then {key:yes} to {npc:Hairycles}. He gives you permission to enter the Forbidden Lands and look for a hair of the holy ape **Bong**.
Ask The Blind Prophet for transport

**East** of Banuta you find {npc:The Blind Prophet}. Say {key:hi} and ask him for {key:transport} to the {wiki:Forbidden Lands|Forbidden Lands}. He is at the foot of the mountain, **east** of Banuta, next to the palisade of the Forbidden Lands. Answer {key:yes} when he asks whether you want to go.

The Forbidden Lands have 2–3 {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths}, 2–4 {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}, many {creature:Massive Earth Elemental|Massive Earth Elementals} and other Tiquanda monsters ({creature:Carniphila|Carniphilas}, {creature:Spit Nettle|Spit Nettles}). The {creature:Hydra|Hydras} are in the northeast and you are unlikely to meet them.

From the Forbidden Lands ramp keep going **west**, along the {wiki:Palisade|palisade} on the **south**, to avoid most monsters (this way you avoid the surface {creature:Behemoth} next to the ramp). When you reach the corner, turn **north** and follow the path until you find a hole (it leads to the hydra cave). You will probably meet a Behemoth as you go up north.
**Northeast** of the hole you find two {item:Giant Footprint|giant footprints}. **Use** the **northwest** square of the **left** footprint to receive the {item:Giant Ape's Hair}.
The two footprints: use the northwest corner of the left one

Go back the same way, along the **south** palisade, to the ramp where {npc:The Blind Prophet} dropped you, and leave through there to Tiquanda. The wiki does not describe this exit in detail. Then return **west** to Banuta.
If you lose the {item:Giant Ape's Hair}, you can buy it from {npc:Black Bert}, but you can only hand it in if you have picked it up yourself once.
Bring the {item:Snake Destroyer} and a melee weapon to break the jars (the Snake Destroyer does not work for that).
Say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to {npc:Hairycles}. You receive the {item:Snake Destroyer} and access to {wiki:Deeper Banuta|Deeper Banuta}, where you have to destroy the snake god's monument.
Without the {item:Snake Destroyer} you cannot finish the quest. Do not leave it in the depot!
Go to this point (floor -2, beneath Banuta) and step into the {wiki:Magic Forcefield|Magic Forcefield} to appear on the first floor of Deeper Banuta.
Green = you start here; yellow = teleport to the next floor
Recommended: bring an {item:Egg of The Many} and use it on the snake head just **east** of the teleport, inside Deeper Banuta, to unlock a secret tunnel from Tiquanda to Deeper Banuta.
Here there are {creature:Green Djinn|Green Djinns}, {creature:Efreet|Efreets}, {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and {creature:Elder Bonelord|Elder Bonelords}, among others.

To go down you have to open this floor's teleport by breaking the **4** {item:Canopic Jar (Object)|Canopic Jars}. The jars come back after a while, so be quick. The best approach is for the team to wait at the **centre** teleport while one person runs around breaking the jars, ignoring the monsters. With two players (one on the **south** side, one on the **north**) it is even faster.
Cyan = start (teleport to the previous floor); green = Canopic Jars to break (4x); yellow = teleport to the next floor
Going down to the quest floor
Once the jars are broken, the whole team steps into the Magic Forcefield in the **centre** of the floor.

When you reach the floor below you may be chased right away by a {creature:Serpent Spawn}. This floor is much harder: {creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts}, {creature:Hydra|Hydras}, {creature:Serpent Spawn|Serpent Spawns} and {creature:Medusa|Medusae}.

{wiki:The Statue of the Snake God|The Statue of the Snake God} is in the **north** room, which is sealed by a wall. To open it, pull the **7 levers** on the floor, all to the **right**. The order does not matter, except for the **last** one: it has to be the lever next to the wall that will disappear. You have limited time to pull them all.
Green = suggested route; yellow = levers to pull (7x); cyan = monument to destroy

The fastest is for a high-level player (200+ recommended) to run the levers ignoring the monsters. Another option: two players split the floor in half, both start in the **southwest** and go in opposite directions.
For lower levels it is dangerous, mainly because of the constant {wiki:Paralysis|paralysis} from the Hydras.

When all the levers have been pulled the wall disappears. Go through the hole in the wall and head **north** to the statue (there are no creatures in this room). Use the {item:Snake Destroyer} on the statue to complete the mission. The {item:Smashed Stone Head} takes 40 seconds to repair itself.
Yellow = wall to remove; green = The Statue of the Snake God

In this room you can pick up the {item:Damaged Steel Helmet} (to the north) if you are doing the {wiki:Knight Outfits Quest|Knight Outfits Quest}. To the east you see the level 999 {item:Door of Expertise}.

When the team is done, leave through the portal at the start of the floor. If the wall comes back and you are on the inside, use the lever next to the wall to open it again. The portal at the start takes you to the **second floor of Banuta** (with apes), not to the floor you came from. From there go up the stairs to the surface of Banuta and to Hairycles' temple.

Go back to {npc:Hairycles}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, then {key:shamanic powers} and {key:yes}. You receive the {wiki:Shaman Outfits|Shaman Outfits}. From now on you can buy the three monkey statues from Hairycles ({item:Monkey Statue (No Hearing)|No Hearing}, {item:Monkey Statue (No Seeing)|No Seeing} and {item:Monkey Statue (No Speaking)|No Speaking}) as {item:Furniture Kit|Furniture Kits} for your house.
Shaman Outfits + access to the Monkey Statues
The quest is also known as Banuta Quest, Ape Quest, Monkey Quest, King Bong Quest, Big Bong Quest or Forbidden Lands Quest.
After the quest you have permanent access to the Forbidden Lands (through The Blind Prophet) and to Deeper Banuta.
